en.role: Forecast following a Board of Directors meeting
en.head: The year ended at 9.52%
en.body: Rosstat estimated that prices rose 9.52% in 2024. That was more than twice the forecast the Bank of Russia reaffirmed in February, when annual inflation was already 7.4%.
